idea-plugin.name: DeviceTree Config Audit
idea-plugin.description:
status = "ok" compiles clean and the node never appears. 23 rules over 7 config languages, on the file you have open.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → DeviceTree Config Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 23 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/devicetree-config-language-pack (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/devicetree-config-language-pack

action.text: DeviceTree Config Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run DeviceTree Config Audit on the file in the editor
